sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: International Time-Definite Small Parcel Courier Operations

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Marshall Islands (Majuro; unitary national jurisdiction without sub-state tax distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: US-derived common-law statutory framework (Business Corporations Act 1990 modeled on Delaware corporate law and the Model Business Corporation Act), unified national legal system under the Constitution of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, with customary law and traditional rights recognized; English is the official legal language.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association (Amended 2003) - Economic Relations Agreement with the United States of America
Pacific Island Countries Trade Agreement (PICTA) - WTO-notified preferential trade agreement among Pacific Islands Forum members
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER-Plus)
US-RMI Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA); no comprehensive income tax DTAA is currently in force for the RMI

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2015 (AMLCFTA 2015), as amended, together with the AML/CFT Regulations 2016 and FIU directives issued by the Financial Intelligence Unit of the Republic of the Marshall Islands; Business Corporations Act 1990 (BCA), as amended, imposing resident-agent duties, registered-office requirements, and beneficial-ownership record-keeping obligations; Registered Agents Act 1991 licensing resident agents; Banking Act 1987 applicable where bank-designated tokens are used; UN sanctions obligations implemented through RMI domestic legal measures.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of the ultimate beneficial owner's (UBO) passport or national identity document
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority or national civil registry of the UBO's country of nationality
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (notary certificate in country of issuance followed by legalization at an RMI diplomatic mission; the Hague Apostille is not recognized because the Republic of the Marshall Islands is not a contracting party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential or business address of the UBO (utility bill or regulated bank statement issued within the preceding 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed utility provider or regulated depository institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (notarized copy; apostille route unavailable for RMI filing purposes)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Incumbency of any corporate shareholder or corporate UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (or an authentic Hague Apostille from an Apostille-party issuing registry, tendered with the licensed resident agent's certification of acceptance as prevailing practice)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds attestation in respect of the UBO or initial subscriber
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Regulated commercial bank or licensed professional (attorney, accountant, or corporate service provider)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (notarized and chain-legalized where the RMI mission requires)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified English translation of any non-English UBO document, with translator's affidavit
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Certified translation provider or sworn court translator
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (translator's notarized affidavit incorporated into the legalization chain)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act (BCA), RMI Revised Code, as amended; Sections 26 (Articles of Incorporation), 27 (Certificate of Incorporation), 31 (Registered Office and Agent), 35 (Bylaws), and 51 (Officers).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands, Corporate Registry Division, Majuro Atoll, MH.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation with attached Consent of Registered Agent (Form RMI-BC-44).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow account requirement; authorized capital may be as low as one par-value share; paid-up capital is determined solely by a board resolution establishing consideration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the bylaws adopted by the incorporator are ratified and adopted as the Bylaws of the Corporation; FURTHER RESOLVED, that the Corporation subscribes for and accepts the issuance of one hundred (100) common shares to the initial shareholder for such consideration as the Board determines; FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office and registered agent stated in the Articles are confirmed as the Corporation’s statutory office and agent; FURTHER RESOLVED, that [Name] is appointed President, [Name] Secretary, and [Name] Treasurer, each to serve at the pleasure of the Board; FURTHER RESOLVED, that the President is authorized to open bank accounts, execute courier operating licenses, customs approvals, and related documents for cross-border express courier operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Availability Search and Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Corporate Registry Division (Name Reservation Desk), Majuro.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a Name Reservation Request confirming the proposed name, e.g., 'ABC Express Courier, Inc.', is distinguishable from existing registrations and does not contain prohibited words ('Bank', 'Trust', 'Insurance') without a special license. Obtain the reservation certificate before filing Articles.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: File a written objection with the Registrar within 30 days of refusal, or amend the proposed name and re-submit the reservation request with an additional US$25 fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Marshall Islands Registered Agent (private law corporation approved by the Registrar).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Articles of Incorporation stating the corporate name, purpose (international express courier and small parcel delivery services), authorized share capital, registered office address in the Marshall Islands, and the registered agent with a signed written Consent of Registered Agent. The incorporator must execute the Articles before a notary public.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any defective or incomplete clauses based on the Registrar's preliminary review comments, re-execute the document, and re-submit with a curative cover letter.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Articles of Incorporation with the Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Corporate Registry Division, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Deliver three notarized copies of the Articles of Incorporation together with the executed Consent of Registered Agent and the statutory filing fee of US$250 (payable by bank remittance or official check). The Registrar reviews the filing for compliance with BCA Sections 26 and 31 before endorsement.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to a Registrar's query letter within 14 calendar days with written explanations or amended documents; pay a US$50 re-filing fee if the Articles are rejected and re-file within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Corporate Registry Division.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon successful review, the Registrar endorses and files one copy of the Articles and returns two conformed copies together with the Certificate of Incorporation. The corporate legal existence commences on the endorsement date; verify the certificate details (name, number, incorporation date) before acceptance.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation issued by Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains clerical errors, submit a written request for administrative correction; if lost, apply for a certified duplicate certificate with a US$50 replacement fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Meeting, Bylaws Adoption, and Officer Appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the Corporation (held at the law office of the registered agent in Majuro or by written consent).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the organizational meeting or execute a unanimous written consent of the sole incorporator/director to adopt the Bylaws, approve the First Board Resolution, subscribe for and issue shares to the initial shareholder, appoint the President, Secretary, and Treasurer, and approve banking and licensing authorities.
required_dossiers: Share subscription agreement and application for shares
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Ratify any omitted corporate action by a unanimous written consent of directors executed within 60 days of the organizational meeting.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Statutory Filings and Franchise Tax Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations and Ministry of Finance, Treasury Division.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the corporation for the annual franchise tax (US$250 for a non-resident corporation), obtain written confirmation of the non-resident tax-exempt status under the RMI income tax regime, and file the initial statement of officers and registered agent if requested by the Registrar.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Pay any late franchise tax with a 10% delinquency penalty and file a corrective return within 60 days; submit a written abatement request to the Ministry of Finance for reasonable cause.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: National Telecommunications Authority (NTA), Postal and Courier Services Division; Ministry of Finance, Business Licensing Division.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Express Courier and Mail Operations License (Postal Sector Class B) and General Business License, both required for international time-definite courier services.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority (RMI EPA), Republic of the Marshall Islands.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B - Registration (Screening Assessment). No full EIA required for a courier depot/warehouse under 500 m2 with a delivery vehicle fleet of fewer than 20 units; a condition-based registration permit is mandatory.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: zero industrial process discharge; stormwater runoff from depot yards must meet pH 6-9, TSS ≤ 50 mg/L, and oil & grease ≤ 10 mg/L. Emissions: no significant VOC threshold for non-fueling operations; vehicle fleet must comply with RMI clean air standards. Solid waste: packaging waste, imported polyethylene, and non-hazardous parcel residues must be segregated and transferred to the RMI national solid waste stream; hazardous or damaged battery-containing shipments must be stored in EPA-approved containers and removed by a licensed waste carrier.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Majuro Fire Department; Building and Structural Occupancy Permit from the Majuro Atoll Local Government (MALGov) Planning Division; workplace safety clearance from the Ministry of Health and Human Services (Occupational Safety Division); and a Customs Bonded Warehouse Approval for cross-border parcel processing from the RMI Customs Service under the Ministry of Finance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Marshall Islands Revenue and Taxation Office (Ministry of Finance, Government of the Republic of the Marshall Islands); filings are administered at the central office in Majuro and through licensed registered agents. No separate nationwide electronic tax filing portal is in active commercial operation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-resident Business Corporation must first be incorporated by a licensed RMI registered agent at the Marshall Islands Registry of Corporations, which issues a statutory corporate registration number. Because the entity is classified as a Tax_Exempt_Zone non-resident corporation and does not derive RMI-source income, no tax identification number or VAT identification number is required at formation. If a future RMI tax liability arises, for example through hiring RMI-resident employees or earning RMI-source income, the company must submit its Certificate of Incorporation, corporate register details, and registration forms to the Revenue and Taxation Office to obtain a Taxpayer Identification Number for income tax, social security, and health fund purposes. No VAT ID exists in the RMI.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: RMI law does not provide a U.S.-style check-the-box election, an elective pass-through classification, or hybrid-mismatch election rules. A non-resident domestic Business Corporation is automatically tax-exempt with respect to RMI income tax while it performs no activities in the RMI and derives no RMI-source income. No affirmative election or annual tax filing is required to preserve this status. Shareholders may voluntarily obtain a tax-residency certificate for banking or treaty purposes, but such a certificate does not alter the entity's statutory Tax_Exempt_Zone classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT, GST, or sales/use tax. The RMI's indirect fiscal regime consists exclusively of customs import duty under MIRC Title 44 and limited municipal licensing charges.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No VAT/GST registration threshold applies, as the RMI does not operate a turnover-based indirect tax system. The official currency is the United States dollar (USD). Cross-border express courier operators acting as importers of record or bonded carriers must register with the Marshall Islands Customs Service for customs entry and clearance purposes, but this registration is based on activity type rather than turnover and has no de minimis threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. The Republic of the Marshall Islands has not enacted any national electronic invoicing mandate, real-time fiscal clearance requirement, continuous transaction control platform, API-connectivity obligation, or digital stamping system. Shipment manifests and export declarations are submitted in paper or electronic format for customs control without any additional fiscal digital certification.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable, as no VAT or GST is chargeable in the RMI. Exports of physical goods and cross-border express courier services originating from the RMI fall outside the scope of RMI indirect taxation; there is no 0% VAT rate to claim and no VAT refund mechanism. Express courier operators may nevertheless use customs duty suspension or relief regimes for imported operational equipment, aircraft waybills, packaging materials, and sorting machinery; those measures are customs-duty concessions and are not export zero-rating.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration / outward cargo manifest filed with the Marshall Islands Customs Service
Commercial invoice or consolidated parcel-value manifest
Packing list, including consolidated dimensional weight manifest
Master Air Waybill / House Air Waybill, and Bill of Lading or multimodal transport document when sea carriage is used
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by an RMI banking counterpart where documentary proof of non-RMI-source service revenue is required by banks or foreign tax authorities
Operator license and customs bond reference in the name of the licensed express carrier
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The RMI does not impose VAT clawback because no export zero-rating regime exists. However, any false export declaration, inaccurate cargo manifest, or misuse of customs duty relief may subject the operator to Marshall Islands Customs Act enforcement, including administrative penalties, forfeiture of goods and carrier equipment, revocation of the express courier license and customs bond, and criminal sanctions for smuggling or fraud comprising fines and imprisonment according to the severity of the offence. Duty-free import concessions used in courier operations may also be retrospectively clawed back, with statutory interest, where the Commissioner of Revenue determines disqualifying use.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) Ministry of Finance, Banking Commission — the statutory banking supervisor acting through the Banking Commissioner under the Banking Act 1991 (as amended). The RMI has no domestic central bank, discount window, or foreign-exchange authority; because the US dollar is the sole official legal tender under the Compact of Free Association, the US Federal Reserve's clearing and monetary-policy framework operates as the de facto central-bank environment for all USD-denominated treasury flows.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: De jure and de facto full convertibility: the RMI maintains zero exchange-control requirements on current-account or capital-account transactions, no profit-remittance licensing, and no separate domestic FX market. A non-resident Business Corporation may freely repatriate dividends, repay shareholder loans, and distribute liquidation proceeds in USD; practical frictions are limited to US OFAC/FinCEN screening, FATCA/CRS reporting, and jurisdiction-risk pricing arising from the RMI's listing on the EU Annex I list of non-cooperative jurisdictions. The treasury model is therefore USD-native, with no conversion gate at the RMI bank layer.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. RMI statute imposes no surrender deadline, no fixed conversion ratio, and no export-receipts escrow for service income. Cross-border express courier proceeds collected via credit-card POS settlement, ACH Direct sweeps, or SWIFT MT103 credits may be retained indefinitely in the operational USD account; the only administrative obligations are accurate books and the annual registry fee filings applicable to non-resident domestic corporations under the Business Corporations Act.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Dual ledger: Capital Escrow Sub-Account for share-capital injections and Operational USD Current Account for courier collections, agent disbursements, and payroll

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam – Majuro Branch (RMI-licensed foreign bank branch)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Clearing Account supporting ACH Direct credits, card-settlement sweeps, and US-dollar correspondent clearing

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. The RMI has no EMI or digital-bank licensing framework, and offshore EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer, Mercury) systematically decline RMI-registered non-resident BCs because the jurisdiction carries EU Annex I listing and elevated jurisdiction-risk scoring; a purely EMI-hosted treasury is structurally unviable. Recommended pivot: retain the regulated RMI bank account as the parent ledger and concentrate US-origin payment rails (credit-card POS and ACH Direct) in a separately incorporated US operating subsidiary that settles intercompany in USD via SWIFT MT103.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person interview is effectively mandatory. BMI and the Bank of Guam Majuro branch require at least one director and the ultimate beneficial owner (or a fully authorized director-signatory) to appear physically at a Majuro branch for CDD; remote video onboarding is not accepted for non-resident BCs. For Bank of Guam, the interview may alternatively be held at the bank's Guam headquarters at the compliance department's discretion; remote notarization is accepted for supporting documents only and never as a substitute for the interview. Budget 6–10 weeks including registered-agent pre-clearance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident, tax-exempt BC status flagged as tax-haven shell
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Good Standing; Articles of Incorporation and Certified Corporate Register under the Business Corporations Act; Minister/Registry position letter confirming non-resident domestic corporation status; registered-agent confirmation of the passthrough operating model; board resolution authorizing the account and describing the ISIC 5320 express courier business rationale.

Registry-issued shareholder ledger evidencing registered shares only; executed beneficial-ownership declaration under the RMI AML/CFT Act 2012 (as amended); passport of each natural-person UBO notarized in RMI and apostilled; corporate structure chart demonstrating UBO identification above the 25% threshold; written confirmation that no bearer instruments are outstanding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border courier receivable volatility and rapid third-party wiring (trade-services red flag)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed customer and courier-agent contracts; 12-month projected volume and settlement-cycle statement; proforma invoices and representative airway-bill sets; list of transit-country agents with OFAC/UN sanctions screening results; source-of-funds escrow letter covering the initial capital injection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Jurisdictional monitoring and correspondent de-risking surcharge
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced due-diligence pack containing CPA-prepared financial statements until the audit threshold is met; negative-media search report; FATCA/CRS registration confirmation; executed transaction-threshold and account-velocity undertakings; a 6-month track record of clean USD clearing once active.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route as a USD-denominated SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's regulated home bank directly to the BMI or Bank of Guam RMI branch, referencing 'MH_BC__ISIC_5320_01/SUB'; use ISO 20022 purpose code SUBS (share subscription) or the bank-accepted capital-purpose narrative. The RMI issues no inward-remittance clearance certificate; however, the beneficiary bank must evidence source of funds because the USD clearing leg transits US correspondents (Fedwire/CHIPS). Verification pack: share subscription agreement, board resolution authorizing issuance, six months of remitting-account statements, beneficial-ownership forms, and a source-of-wealth declaration. ACH Direct sweeps from US processors are credited to the operational account only after the initial wire verification is completed.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary settlement rail is USD SWIFT MT103 (open account) for airline, last-mile, customs-broker, and regional-agent payables, with SWIFT MT101 batch multiples for recurring aggregator settlements; US-based logistics partners may be paid via ACH Direct (CCD/CTX) enabled on the operational account. Commercial letters of credit (sight or 30-day usance, issued by a top-50 bank) are used only where destination-country procurement rules or shipper contracts demand documentary protection; the standard express-courier model remains open-account MT103. Card collections (Visa/Mastercard MCC 4215 – Courier Services) settle through the merchant acquirer into the US operating subsidiary and are swept intercompany daily; the treasury maintains a three-settlement-week USD liquidity buffer. Note: because RMI domestic banks do not offer treasury derivatives, every instrument in the permissible hedging array must be executed through the offshore counterparty master account under an ISDA 2002/CSA governed by English or New York law.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright USD cross-currency forwards on G10 currencies (EUR, GBP, AUD, JPY, NZD) for courier cost corridors
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on CNH/CNY, PHP, IDR, and VND for Asia-Pacific route settlement protection
Rolling short-dated FX swaps and spot-forward ladders for working-capital conversion between the USD clearing base and local-currency disbursement accounts
Cross-currency floating-fixed swaps limited to balance-sheet hedging of intercompany funding with the US operating subsidiary

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Finance and Development, RMI (via Registered Agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary date of incorporation; for companies incorporated 1 January – 30 June, 30 September of the same calendar year; for companies incorporated 1 July – 31 December, 31 March of the ensuing calendar year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee of US$100 per month or part thereof; failure to file for 3 months triggers a closure order; continued default warrants administrative dissolution and strike-off from the Company Register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same deadline as the Annual Corporate Report (anniversary-date based fixed filing schedule).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% surcharge on unpaid tax every 30 days; unpaid franchise tax for one year forfeits the company's charter and permits the Registrar to dissolve the entity without further notice.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Resident Agent, with onward confidential recording with the Registrar and Financial Intelligence Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same due date as the annual report; also required within 30 days after any change of beneficial owner.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Civil penalty up to US$10,000 per violation and personal criminal liability for officers for knowingly providing false beneficial ownership information.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit for non-resident tax-exempt business corporations. Audit is mandatory if the corporation is licensed by the RMI Telecommunications Ministry to provide cross-border courier services and has consolidated annual turnover exceeding US$5,000,000, or if the company is a public-interest entity under the Banking and Insurance Acts.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as issued by the IASB; non-resident tax-exempt companies may maintain IFRS for SMEs or simplified cash-basis records for internal management.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Each beneficial owner identified at the 10% threshold must deliver an executed confirmation statement to the Resident Agent on or before the 30th day following each corporate anniversary; this confirmation is refreshed contemporaneously with any share transfer or pledge that changes control and remains a private document, accessible only to supervisory authorities.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 20% flat corporate income tax (CIT) under the Income Tax Act 1989, as amended, on taxable income of corporations outside the non-resident exemption; 0% effective tax rate for a qualifying Non-Resident Business Corporation (BC) exempt under Section 107 of the Business Corporations Act 1990 (BCA).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory exemption for non-resident domestic BCs from RMI income tax, withholding tax, capital gains tax, gross revenue tax, and stamp taxes on all income derived outside the Republic of the Marshall Islands (BCA Section 107). No gross receipts tax on non-resident BCs. The sole annual fiscal cost is the corporate annual franchise fee, USD 50 to USD 350 based on authorized share capital, plus the registered agent fee.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form AR (Annual Corporate Report) and Annual Franchise Tax, filed with the RMI Registrar of Corporations, Majuro; submission is made electronically through the entity's licensed RMI registered agent portal, not through a direct taxpayer e-filing system.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on the anniversary date of incorporation in each calendar year; no extension is available. Payment of the annual franchise fee is a precondition to the filing being accepted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate name and RMI registration number exactly as stated in the Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm the BC designation; the words 'Non-Resident' must be reflected in the registered particulars where the BCA non-resident status has been elected; mismatch invalidates the filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent name and registered office street address in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A licensed RMI registered agent and a physical Majuro address are mandatory for a non-resident BC; a post office box alone is not acceptable and service of process will be made at this address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Principal operational business address outside the RMI, including the head office, hub, or sorting facility of the cross-border express courier business.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the full foreign operational address and legal entity identifiers (FEIN, VAT number) of the group's operating company; this supports the territoriality claim of the non-resident exemption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors and officers: full legal name, nationality, residential address, and identification document number for each director, secretary, and officer.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The BCA permits a single director or corporate director; non-resident individuals are eligible. Provide complete data for all registered directors; omissions trigger Registrar rejection and good-standing suspension.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized share capital, number of shares, par value, and class structure (e.g., common or preferred), in USD or another stated currency.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The annual franchise fee is computed from authorized capital; a non-resident BC may declare the minimum authorized capital and increase it later by board resolution and amendment filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Issued share capital and total consideration received for issued shares.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Issued shares may be nil or fully unpaid at incorporation; if the courier group capitalizes the BC, report the paid-in amount accurately to align with transfer pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-Resident Tax-Exempt Declaration under BCA Section 107: confirmation that no income was derived from sources within the Republic of the Marshall Islands during the reporting year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This box is the legal linchpin of the 0% CIT position. An affirmative declaration must be supported by board minutes and a revenue-source schedule demonstrating that all courier revenue arises outside the RMI. Filing a false declaration is a criminal offence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Economic substance and commercial domicile narrative: summary of where the courier business is managed, staffed, and operated, and identification of the core income-generating activities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the operating market (e.g., United States, EU, APAC), number of employees, and physical presence of the sorting hubs and last-mile network. This narrative must be consistent with the group's Master File and Local File economic substance assertions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual franchise fee computation based on authorized capital.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the scale (USD 50 for capital up to USD 10,000; USD 100 up to USD 100,000; USD 200 up to USD 1,000,000; USD 350 above USD 1,000,000). Payment must accompany the form.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing and non-payment of the franchise fee incur a penalty of 10% of the annual fee for each month of delinquency, capped at 100%; delinquency beyond six months permits the Registrar to administratively dissolve the corporation, revoke its certificate, and strike the entity from the registry; reinstatement requires a formal application, all arrears, and reinstatement fees.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: RMI Corporate Income Tax Return under the Income Tax Act 1989, as amended; paper filing delivered to the RMI Tax Office, Ministry of Finance, Majuro. This return is not required for an exempt non-resident BC and applies only in the exceptional case where the non-resident exemption is lost or RMI-source income is derived.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing is due within the period prescribed by the RMI Tax Office for the tax year, generally within four months after the close of the corporation's fiscal year-end; the RMI Tax Office may prescribe a uniform calendar-year deadline.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income derived from sources within the Republic of the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Allocate and apportion courier revenue by RMI-source rules; only revenue attributable to the transportation, pickup, or delivery of parcels within the territory of the RMI is taxable to a non-resident corporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allowable deductions, being ordinary and necessary expenses directly attributable to the RMI-source gross income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Intercompany charges to related entities must satisfy an arm's length standard even absent formal RMI transfer pricing legislation; excessive management fees or royalty payments to offshore affiliates will be disallowed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income, calculated as RMI-source gross income less allowable deductions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the corporation elects to claim the non-resident exemption, this line must be nil and the supporting territoriality schedule attached.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate tax at statutory rate of 20%.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply 20% only where RMI-source income exists; an exempt non-resident BC computes zero and files a nil return if expressly required by the Tax Office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax prepayments, foreign tax credits, and any applicable economic development incentive credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The RMI does not grant foreign tax credits to non-resident BCs; credits claimed must be evidenced by credible supporting documentation.
Where tax is due, wire payment is made to the RMI Tax Office consolidated revenue account; late payment accrues monthly default interest.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file an RMI corporate income tax return subjects the entity to a penalty of 25% of the tax due; non-payment accrues monthly default interest; willful evasion is prosecutable as a criminal offence with monetary penalties and imprisonment, and the BCA Section 107 exemption is void for the offending tax year.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0%. The Marshall Islands imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by a Business Corporation, whether distributed as an interim dividend, final dividend, or liquidation distribution, and regardless of the residence or nationality of the shareholder.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The RMI has no comprehensive double taxation agreement (DTA) network with the United States, EU member states, or Asia-Pacific markets served by the cross-border courier business; therefore, no treaty rate relief protocol is applicable. Because the domestic dividend withholding rate is already 0%, no reduction at source is required. Where the shareholder's home jurisdiction requests a Certificate of Tax Residency or an Exemption Confirmation, the BC must submit a written application through its registered agent to the RMI Tax Office, attaching a certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation, a completed BCA Section 107 declaration, and payment of the administrative certification fee; issuance generally occurs within 10 business days and is valid for the fiscal year of issue.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding rates: 0% for cross-border royalties and 0% for cross-border interest paid by an RMI payer to a non-resident. No DTA-reduced rates are required because no domestic WHT is imposed. Accordingly, the BC may license courier technology platforms, sortation software, and trademarks, and may service intercompany debt at market rates without any RMI tax leakage; any exemption confirmation letter will state that RMI source taxation does not arise on such payments.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable: the RMI Income Tax Act contains no transfer pricing documentation legislation, and no Local File or Master File threshold is imposed on a non-resident tax-exempt BC. The operative threshold is territorial: all income of the BC derived outside the RMI is outside the CIT net. For practical multi-jurisdiction compliance, the group must satisfy OECD transfer pricing master file and local file obligations in the operating markets where courier services are performed, with intercompany agreements and functional analyses prepared to the OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines standard, particularly where last-mile delivery fees, hub handling charges, and technology royalties are settled among affiliates.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP (Comparable Uncontrolled Price): applicable to intercompany last-mile delivery services and per-parcel transshipment fees where comparable logistics pricing exists.
Resale Price Method: applicable to the distribution of courier supplies, packaging materials, and scanning hardware intercompany sales.
Cost Plus Method: applicable to sorting, warehousing, customs brokerage, and hub handling services rendered at a defined cost base plus arm's length markup.

TNMM (Transactional Net Margin Method): the most appropriate default method for integrated express courier logistics providers where the tested party is the RMI BC performing routine intermediate services.

Profit Split Method: applicable to the integrated worldwide time-definite delivery network where both parties contribute unique intangibles, such as proprietary route optimization software and customer networks.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The RMI does not yet apply a BVI-style Economic Substance Act to non-resident BCs; however, the BCA Section 107 exemption is structured as a territorial tax-exempt zone and requires two substantive conditions: (1) the corporation derives no income from RMI sources, and (2) the commercial substance of the enterprise is located outside the RMI. The mandatory Annual Corporate Report requires a signed declaration of economic presence and commercial domicile. Under OECD Global Forum and EU Code of Conduct Group peer review, an RMI BC acting as a pure booking vehicle for cross-border courier profit, with no employees, premises, or management functions in the operating territory, is rebuttably presumed to be a shell; such presumption triggers foreign CFC, GILTI, and substance-over-form recharacterizations, loss of the RMI exemption, and potential blacklisting consequences for the jurisdiction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion: Conducting RMI-Source Domestic Courier Business While Claiming the Non-Resident Exemption
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The BC performs domestic point-to-point express delivery within the Marshall Islands (e.g., Majuro to Ebeye), collects RMI-source waybill revenue, or operates an RMI-domiciled sorting facility or local customer call center, while simultaneously filing the BCA Section 107 non-resident declaration and paying zero corporate income tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Retroactive revocation of the non-resident exemption for the offending tax years; full assessment of corporate income tax at 20% on all undeclared RMI-source income; default interest at 2% per month; an evasion penalty of up to 100% of the tax deficiency; forfeiture of the right to transact business in the RMI; and reference to criminal prosecution under the Income Tax Act 1989.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, officers, and the registered agent who executed or approved the false declaration are jointly and severally liable for the assessed tax, interest, and penalties under corporate veil-piercing principles; the RMI may issue a departure/travel ban against the directors; on criminal conviction, directors face imprisonment and monetary fines.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company Abuse and Sham Substance Structure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The RMI BC has no bank account, no employees, no physical premises, and no board decision-making in the Marshall Islands; it book-records the entire margin of the cross-border time-definite courier network and accumulates distributable surplus, while all operational substance, negotiation, and management occur in high-tax markets. This arrangement functions solely to shift profit to a zero-rate jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: At the RMI level: administrative dissolution by the Registrar for sham particulars, rejection of the Annual Corporate Report, and withdrawal of the certificate of good standing. At the foreign level: recharacterization of the BC as a resident or permanent establishment, mandatory CFC/GILTI inclusions, transfer pricing adjustments, denial of treaty and foreign tax credit protections, and anti-avoidance penalties of up to 100% of the tax recomputed in the operating jurisdictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal civil restitution claims in foreign courts and in liquidation proceedings for fraudulent transfer and wrongful trading; promoters of the sham structure are exposed to conspiracy and tax-shelter promotion prosecutions; international travel restrictions and extradition requests may be pursued in egregious cross-border abuse cases.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT Failures on Enhanced-Risk Courier Payment Rails
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The express courier business, rated Medium-Risk Enhanced, processes high-volume Credit Card POS and ACH Direct payments for time-definite parcel shipments without conducting beneficial ownership and customer due diligence, fails to file currency transaction reports on aggregated cash or near-cash prepayments, or knowingly transports value-dense items (cash, negotiable instruments, bank cards, precious metals) as part of trade-based money laundering or sanctions evasion.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Enforcement under the RMI Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2020 and the National Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Risk Assessment framework: administrative monetary penalties against the BC of up to USD 1,000,000 per violation; license suspension or revocation of the statutory courier operating license; seizure of assets under mutual legal assistance; and blacklisting from correspondent banking settlement rails.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, beneficial owners, compliance officers, and Money Laundering Reporting Officers face personal criminal prosecution, fines of up to USD 500,000, and imprisonment of up to 15 years; additionally, the RMI Registrar may disqualify the directors from serving on any RMI-incorporated entity, their personal assets may be frozen, and re-entry to the RMI is barred.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False Statements to the Registrar and Fraudulent Exemption Claims
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly furnishing materially false information in the Annual Corporate Report, including an untrue BCA Section 107 non-resident declaration, misidentified directors or officers, inflated or understated authorized capital to reduce the franchise fee, or a contradicted economic substance narrative, with the intent to deceive the Registrar of Corporations and the RMI Tax Office.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Cancellation of the corporate registration and certificate of good standing; administrative strike-off and dissolution without the benefit of winding-up protections; imposition of reinstatement penalties and a fresh incorporation requirement; criminal liability for false corporate filings under the Business Corporations Act; and revocation of the tax-exempt status ab initio.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who authorized the false filing are personally liable for all franchise fees, penalties, and restored taxes; they face criminal fines and custodial sentences for perjury-related corporate offences; in any subsequent insolvency, civil courts may order restitution in favor of creditors who relied upon the false certification, and the directors' personal travel and banking privileges are subject to restriction.
